tests.report:
Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed) and the direction forward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: Status badge showed 'In Fahrt', Stop was clicked; stop lists set to Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4 and Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2; Start clicked (approx. 22:24:49 mock time), waited 15 s. Mock console: 'Speed (0-255)' of both trains is 0; the newest message in the log is from 22:23:47 (before this Start); no message was sent to Bahn 1 or Bahn 2 after Start. Histories: Bahn 1 '0 forward → 60 backward → 0 backward → 120 forward → 0 forward → 120 forward → 0 forward', Bahn 2 '0 forward → 60 forward → 0 forward → 120 backward → 120 forward → 0 forward' – all 120 entries stem from the earlier operation before this test. The Start under test produced no drive commands.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Train positions move live in the preview
Expected: At least one train marker is at a clearly different place on the track in the second screenshot
Observed failure: App opened with status 'In Fahrt' and speed 0; Stop was clicked, stop lists set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2) and Start clicked. Screenshots of the track graphic after 5 s and after a further 3 s show both markers ('Bahn 1' just right of Haltestelle 1 on the top straight, 'Bahn 2' just left of the curve to Haltestelle 2) at identical positions; train positions do not move.
Steps completed before failure: 7

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; the two trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: Status showed 'In Fahrt'; Stop clicked ('Gestoppt'), both stop lists were empty and were set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2); Start clicked, badge 'In Fahrt', log entry 'Start' at 23:27:48. Screenshots after 10 s, +5 s and a further one show both markers at exactly the same place on the top straight; Bahn 2 shows 'Geschwindigkeit 0' throughout; no new log entries after Start. Only 3 of 5 screenshots taken because the action budget was used up by re-entering the empty stop lists; no movement observed over approx. 15 s.
Steps completed before failure: 8

Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving
Observed failure: Before Start the history of 'Weichen' was '#1: 1 → 2, #1: 2 → 1' (applied: 3). In the app the badge showed 'In Fahrt', Stop was clicked, stop lists set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2), Start clicked, waited 2 × 30 s. Mock console afterwards: history still exactly '#1: 1 → 2, #1: 2 → 1', counter still 'applied: 3', all switches on track 1. No new switch changes.
Steps completed before failure: 12

Feature: Head-on meeting: one train evades to the siding
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains at least one entry '<train> weicht aus' and, later, an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis' for the same train
Observed failure: App showed 'In Fahrt', Stop clicked, stop lists set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2), Start clicked (log 'Start' 23:31:47), waited 3 × 30 s. Badge 'In Fahrt' but speed of selected train 0. In the Betriebsprotokoll 'Start' at 23:31:47 is still the newest entry, nothing after it: no 'weicht aus', no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis'.
Steps completed before failure: 9

Feature: After a meeting both trains continue (no deadlock)
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains an entry '<train> wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', later '<train> fährt weiter' for the same train, and after that further entries '… erreicht …' for both 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: App showed 'In Fahrt', Stop clicked; both stop lists empty, set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2); Start clicked (log 'Start' 23:34:34), waited 4 × 30 s. 'Start 23:34:34' is still the newest log entry; no 'wartet auf dem Ausweichgleis', no 'fährt weiter', no 'erreicht' for either train.
Steps completed before failure: 10

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: App showed 'In Fahrt', Stop clicked; both stop lists empty, set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2); Start clicked. Screenshot of the track graphic approx. 4 s after Start (action budget used up, so only one screenshot instead of three after 8 s each): 'Bahn 1' just right of Haltestelle 1 and 'Bahn 2' just left of Haltestelle 2, both on the same top straight section; no train on the siding. Markers do not overlap but share one track section; neither train waits or evades.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2', later 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 4' and later again 'Bahn 1 erreicht Haltestelle 2'
Observed failure: App showed 'In Fahrt' with empty stop lists; Stop clicked, stop lists set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2), Start clicked (log 'Start' 23:39:32). Final snapshot: 'Start' is still the newest log entry, no 'erreicht' entry, speed 0. Tester deviation: the five 30 s waits were sent in parallel, so only approx. 33 s passed between Start and the final snapshot instead of 150 s; the action budget was then used up.
Steps completed before failure: 6

Feature: Recalibration during operation
Expected: Since the last 'Start' the log contains '<train> wird kalibriert' followed later by '<train> ist kalibriert' for the same train, and the mock history of this train shows normal speed, then the low calibration speed, then normal speed again
Observed failure: App showed 'In Fahrt' with empty stop lists; Stop clicked, stop lists set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2), Start clicked, waited 4 × 30 s. Newest log entry still 'Start' (23:41:34), no newer entries: no calibration entries, no train events. Mock console not opened (action budget nearly used up, expected log entries already missing).
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Operation can be started again after a Stop
Expected: The log shows, from old to new, 'Start', 'Stop' and 'Start' again, and after the second 'Start' at least one new entry '<train> erreicht <stop>'
Observed failure: Badge 'Gestoppt', both stop lists empty; set (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 2, Haltestelle 4; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 4, Haltestelle 2). Start (23:49:44), 20 s, Stop (23:50:10), 3 s, Start (23:50:18), 2 × 30 s. Final snapshot: Start/Stop/Start in correct order, but no entry newer than the Start at 23:50:18 – no train reached a stop after the restart.
Steps completed before failure: 12
